dissent: On currently reachable retained cases exact equality coincides with paired reply equality, so finding 3 is latent, not an observed false counterexample.

assert-based schema (:56-57) vanishes under -O and sorted(row) (:70) raises on non-iterable rows; minor robustness, excluded from top-4.
findings: inspect_cases never binds row actions to the trace: ROW_KEYS (:30) omits 'adapter_action' and `verb` (:72) comes only from row['source_action']; nothing requires rows[i-1] actions == events[i-1]['action'] == case['source']['actions'][i-1], which adapter_traces.restore ('literal occurrence and outer dependency') and check.py audit_case ('literal chronological event equality') enforce. Verb gates every reply check (:92-96). Fixture: successful pub-commit case; set rows[k]['source_action']='attempt:2@k' and delete adapter_observation['publication_reply'] -> all state hashes valid, reply checks skipped, status 'supported'. Fix: require three-way action equality; add label-forgery control.

row['q_invoked'] is trusted (:84): the invoked branch checks outer==core decision but skips core-unchanged; the non-invoked branch checks adp[i]['core']==adp[i-1]['core'] (:90-91) only under the flag. Retained invocations and core['done'] mask are never cross-checked, though a_audit.check requires 'actual Q response and invocation inventory' and exact Q completion. Fixture: refused prefix whose adapter patch corrupts a non-decision core field; forge rows[k]['q_invoked']=True then _rebind -> violation hidden, 'supported'. No control exercises flag forgery (cf. wave04 'falseQinvocationonrefusedattest'). Fix: rederive invoked-ness from invocations delta/core done; control it.

publication_reply uses rel.exact (:95-96,:103-104), but adapter_traces.response requires semantic field_pair/pair_receipt under the incarnation-pair ledger; inspect_cases never reconstructs pairs. An honest case with paired-but-distinct envelope source_generation/signature would falsely report 'publication_reply-cross-side'; own_receipt structure unchecked. Latent: exact==paired on currently reachable cases. Fix: rebuild pairs via rel.advance over core_view per prefix, or downgrade the claim to exact equality.

Finite precharge incomplete: replay() materializes both full histories at :55 before the first charge.take(1) (:63); malformed cases consume zero charge despite full replay; the per-prefix unit '1' under-covers the two-side sha256 binds+exact work, diverging from c.Counter take(2)-per-transition and boundary 70/history reservation conventions. Fix: charge inside replay per reconstructed state (both sides) and before schema asserts.
